tasks.title: 冻结消费者证据与 PS7-only 支持决策
tasks.goal: 区分微软生命周期事实、项目支持决定、当前消费者与历史兼容证据，冻结不启动 typed-core 生产迁移的边界。
preconditions: PowerShell 7 is already the authoritative build/test/full runtime
the user explicitly authorized removal of current Windows PowerShell 5.1 support
TC2 remains not_started and P6 remains hold
implementation_steps: inventory active 5.1 resolver, CI, test, documentation and release touchpoints
review Microsoft lifecycle and 5.1-to-7 migration guidance
classify current support references versus immutable historical facts
freeze ps7_only, rollback and truth boundaries
tests: official references and project-support disclaimer exist
historical phase manifest retains its original 5.1 evidence
rollback: revert only the current migration decision assets; do not rewrite historical phase truth
done_when: support decision, alternative, migration and rollback are explicit
legacy current support and historical evidence are separated

tasks.title: 收敛生产入口、生成链和受管子进程
tasks.goal: 使 source、generated bundle、installer、CMD wrapper 与 MCP environment wrapper 只执行 PowerShell 7，并在缺失时 fail-closed。
preconditions: generated skills.ps1 is changed only through build.ps1
implementation_steps: raise script requirements to 7.0
delete CODEX_ALLOW_WINDOWS_POWERSHELL and powershell.exe resolution
add installer PS7 preflight after function declaration
make skills.cmd resolve only pwsh and return 9009 when absent
regenerate skills.ps1 with deterministic UTF-8 BOM
tests: installer and CMD failures are diagnostic
rollback: revert this source slice and rebuild; never hand-edit skills.ps1
done_when: all supported entry paths use pwsh
legacy fallback tokens are absent from active execution paths

tasks.title: 迁移 CI、测试和 AI PowerShell 指导
tasks.goal: 删除 5.1 CI/smoke 与 silent skip，把受影响 subprocess fixtures 和 AI 自动化指导统一到 PowerShell 7。
implementation_steps: remove Windows PowerShell CI jobs and legacy shell syntax
run focused child-process fixtures through pwsh
replace bounded compatibility tests with PS7 runtime/fail-closed contracts
make the reusable automation skill PS7-first with explicit external-legacy exception
tests: CI files contain no legacy job
focused fixtures execute under PSEdition Core
no test treats missing powershell.exe as success
rollback: revert only converted CI/test/skill files together with the runtime source slice
done_when: tests fail closed on policy drift
AI guidance no longer adds implicit 5.1 fallback

tasks.title: 同步产品、规划、发布与全局默认合同
tasks.goal: 消除 code/docs 双真值，提供可执行迁移/回滚指南，并把 Windows PS7-first 默认投影到本机全局 AI 规则。
preconditions: active code and CI policy are stable
host-global files are backed up before writes
implementation_steps: replace current ps7_primary_ps51_bounded_smoke truth with ps7_only
update PP-012, NFR-PORT-001, NFR-EWF-006, ADR-SMV-002, TC2 gate and RISK-021
add migration, release and rollback boundaries
backup and update host-global common rules without editing config.toml or restarting hosts
preserve fresh-task loading as an external verification boundary
tests: host-global files contain the same PS7 default rule
rollback: restore host-global backups and revert current repo docs; validate only in a fresh task
done_when: host-global guidance is backed up and file-verified

tasks.title: 建立 runtime policy verifier 并完成证据和 Git 收口
tasks.goal: 用 current/negative verifier、focused tests、唯一 full gate 和 Git parity 证明同一最终 write set 的 repo-side PS7-only closeout。
preconditions: parallel main worktree changes are preserved
implementation_steps: implement version, fallback, CI, current-truth, history and typed-core boundary findings
add current pass and fail-closed negative Pester fixtures
wire runtime policy into the contract/invariant portion of the full gate
run focused verifiers then one full gate for the final write set
commit the isolated branch, integrate latest main serially, rerun full and push without force
rollback: revert only this migration commit; regenerate bundle and rerun full; do not overwrite unrelated main worktree changes
done_when: reviewed evidence names exact truth boundary
branch is safely integrated and remote parity is proven
